_description: Disagreements recorded by the classical sources *inside* a counting system, between the authorities through whom the system was transmitted. The vendored qiraat-ayah-map primitives give each system one settled position per point; this overlay says where the system's own authorities differ, so an edition's choice at such a point can be named rather than reported as an error. Anchors use the same (surah, kufi ayah, kind, word) key as the primitives. Every entry cites its source. When qiraat-ayah-map models this itself (their issue #11), entries here are deleted in favour of theirs.
